title: Subterrane: all-night techno with Anastasia Kane
description: A foggy concrete room, a wall of sound, and one resident on the decks until 6am. No phones on the floor, just the rig and the regulars.

title: ShipIt 2026 Platform Engineering Summit
description: Two days of deep dives on platform engineering, internal developer portals, and shipping reliably at scale. Hallway track, live demos, and office hours with the maintainers behind the tools you use daily.

title: Nexus Invitational grand finals
description: The top eight teams of the 2026 season clash on the main stage for the championship trophy. Doors open two hours early for the fan zone and player meet and greet.

title: Riverline City Half Marathon 2026
description: A fast, flat half marathon along the riverfront avenues with live music every kilometer and chip timing. Wave starts open at sunrise.

title: Chef's table: 14 seats at the pass
description: Pull up to the pass for a 12-course tasting menu plated in front of you. The kitchen talks through each dish as it lands.

title: Quiet Geometry: opening night
description: An intimate first look at a new minimalist photography show, with the artist walking guests through each frame. Small room, slow evening, a glass of natural wine in hand.

title: Sunrise shoreline cleanup at Sandymount
description: Join a two hour cleanup along the waterfront before the morning crowds arrive. Gloves, bags, and coffee are provided, and every volunteer logs what they collect for the city open data project.

title: Autumn flu and RSV vaccination drop-in
description: Walk in for a quick seasonal flu or RSV shot administered by registered nurses. Slots run every ten minutes and most visits take under fifteen.

title: Phantom Sole Vol. 3 sneaker drop
description: A limited run of 220 hand finished pairs from the Phantom Sole line. First come, first served, one pair per person while stock lasts.

title: Rooftop opening set with DJ Sora
description: Sunset to midnight on a downtown rooftop with a deep house warm up and skyline views. Limited floor, open air, one continuous mix.

title: Helio One Keynote and Hardware Reveal
description: The annual keynote where Helio unveils its next-generation devices and developer platform. Seats are drawn by lottery, with hands-on demo stations open right after the show.

title: 48 hour summer game jam
description: Build a playable game from scratch in one weekend around a theme revealed at kickoff. Mentors, free snacks, and a public demo session on Sunday evening.

title: Night Session Bouldering Throwdown
description: An after-hours bouldering jam with fresh problem sets across all grades, a coached warm up, and finals on the comp wall. Shoes and chalk provided.

title: Old vine syrah, eight glasses deep
description: A guided pour through eight old vine syrahs from a single hillside, with the winemaker walking the room. Snacks and spit buckets provided.
venue: Cellar and Slope Tasting Room, Cape Town

title: Three Figures, one red curtain
description: A movement-led theatre piece staged in near silhouette, told entirely through shadow and gesture. Seats are drawn by lottery to keep the front rows fair for everyone.

title: Pop up blood donation clinic
description: Book a 30 minute slot to give blood at our mobile clinic. First time donors are welcome and a nurse walks you through every step before you relax with a snack afterward.

title: Friday evening singing bowl sound bath
description: Lie back on a mat and unwind to an hour of Himalayan singing bowls and gentle breath cues. Mats, bolsters and eye pillows are provided.

title: Calibre 01 skeleton release
description: Forty individually numbered automatic skeleton watches, allocated by open lottery. Winners are drawn at the close of the entry window.

title: Pulse 2026: arena electronic showcase
description: A full arena production with laser walls, four headline acts, and a stage built around the crowd. Enter the draw for general admission floor access.

title: Frontier AI Summit: Agents and Evals
description: A focused single-track summit on agentic systems, evaluation harnesses, and safe deployment. Researchers and practitioners share what actually works in production, not just on benchmarks.

title: OpenForge global hack weekend
description: A worldwide build sprint focused on open source tooling and small multiplayer prototypes. Tracks for solo builders and teams, with hardware loaners available on site.

title: All-Star Showcase Courtside Seats
description: Lower-bowl seats to the regional all-star showcase with a halftime skills contest and a player meet and greet. Entries are drawn at the end of the window.

title: Single origin cupping: the 2026 harvest
description: Slurp your way through this year's lots side by side and score them on the table. Lead roasters break the crust and pour with you.

title: Premiere night at the old picture house
description: The first public screening of an independent feature, followed by a live director and cast conversation. Entry is balloted across the window so the room stays open to newcomers.

title: Meet and greet adoption afternoon
description: Spend unhurried time with dogs and cats looking for a home in a calm, small group setting. Our fosters share each animal's story and help you find the right match for your household.

title: Three day coastal wellness reset
description: A small group weekend of sunrise yoga, ocean swims and slow meals above the cliffs. Lodging and all sessions are included for everyone selected.
venue: Cabo da Roca Lodge, Lisbon, Portugal

title: Midnight Sessions 180g vinyl
description: A one time pressing of 500 audiophile 180 gram records, cut from the original tapes. Claim your copy in real time when the drop opens.

title: Late set: a brass quartet in the round
description: An intimate basement room, candlelit tables, and a quartet playing two short sets with no setlist. Seating is first come, drinks at the bar.

title: 48 Hour Build Night Hackathon
description: Form a team, pick a problem, and ship something real in a weekend. Mentors on hand, snacks all night, and a demo showcase to close it out.

title: Halcyon overnight LAN party
description: Bring your rig for a sold out night of bracket play, free for all rounds, and late night co-op. Power, hundred gigabit switching, and unlimited cold brew provided.

title: Midweek Derby Under the Lights
description: Floodlit midweek derby tickets in the standing section, with a pre-match warm up zone and supporter scarves at the gate. A windowed draw keeps it fair.

title: Cocktail lab: shaken, stirred, built
description: Three stations, three techniques, and a head bartender at each one. Build five drinks and keep the recipe cards to take home.

title: Museum after dark: the lit cases
description: Roam the galleries by low light after closing, with curators posted at the cases to answer anything. A torch-lit route, a late espresso bar, and far fewer people than a normal day.

title: Weekend food drive sorting shift
description: Help sort and pack donated groceries into family hampers for neighbours facing tight weeks. Shifts run back to back through the day and no experience is needed to pitch in.

title: Free dental check and cleaning camp
description: Volunteer dentists offer free exams, scaling and digital scans across the day. Bring any prior records and arrive a few minutes before your slot.

title: Strata lounge chair limited edition
description: Twenty four numbered Strata chairs moulded from recycled ocean plastic. Enter the draw and we will notify selected buyers when the window closes.

title: Nocturne: a candlelit symphony evening
description: A full orchestra performs a late evening program in a historic hall lit only by warm house lights. Seats are assigned by random draw across all tiers.

title: Systems Programming Meetup and Lightning Talks
description: An intimate evening of lightning talks on memory safety, async runtimes, and embedded systems. Bring a laptop, swap war stories, and stay for the open hacking session.

title: Indie night: unreleased builds
description: Hands on time with a dozen unreleased indie titles, followed by a Q and A with the developers. Vote for the audience favorite to win the showcase grant.

title: Coastal GranFondo 120k Open Ride
description: A timed 120 kilometer coastal road ride with three feed stations, neutral support, and a closed-road finishing straight. Mass start by category.

title: Candlelit supper club, one long table
description: Strangers become a table over a five-course family-style menu by candlelight. Seating is communal and rotates between courses.

title: Milky Way watch above the pines
description: A guided stargazing night far from city glow, with telescopes set up and an astronomer narrating the sky overhead. Bring a blanket, leave the headlights off.

title: Neighbourhood town hall on the new park plan
description: Bring your questions to an open forum where planners and residents talk through the riverside park proposal. Seats are limited, so a fair draw decides who joins the room.

title: City wide preventive health screening day
description: Selected attendees get blood pressure, cholesterol, glucose and BMI checks plus a short consult with a clinician. Results are shared the same day.
venue: ExCeL Health Pavilion, London, United Kingdom

title: Capsule No. 7 fashion preview
description: An intimate in store preview of the No. 7 capsule with sixty appointment slots. Book early to walk the rail before the public launch.

title: Strings after dark: a live scoring session
description: A string ensemble scores a short film live, performed twice in one night for a small standing audience. Win a slot through the entry window.

title: Spatial Computing Showcase and Demo Day
description: Try the latest mixed reality headsets and spatial apps from indie studios and research labs. Live demos, builder talks, and a hands-on lab to test your own ideas.

title: Mainloop: shipping games with small teams
description: An evening of three short talks on engine choices, live ops, and launch day survival, plus open networking. Recordings shared with attendees afterward.

title: Sunrise Rooftop Yoga and Breathwork
description: A small sunrise flow on the rooftop deck with guided breathwork and a cold brew after class. Mats and props are set out for you.

title: Lantern night market: 60 stalls after dark
description: Sixty street food stalls open under the lanterns for one night, from grilled skewers to late night noodles. Free entry pass holds your spot.

title: Skyline photo walk at last light
description: A small group walk chasing the sunset across rooftops and waterfronts, with a working photographer sharing composition tips as you shoot. Any camera or phone welcome.

title: Citywide tree planting volunteer day
description: Thousands of volunteers fan out across the city to plant native saplings in one coordinated morning. Enter the draw for a spot, choose your nearest site, and we supply the tools and training.

title: Burnout and boundaries small group workshop
description: A licensed therapist guides a candid two hour session on spotting burnout and setting healthier limits at work and home. Notebooks and tea provided.

title: Aura Pro earbuds first wave
description: The first 3000 units of the Aura Pro wireless earbuds, allocated by global lottery. Enter once and we draw fairly across every region.
